title: One Lakh Reward Criminal Arrested in Hapur
summary: Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF) arrested a criminal, Kala Irani, who was carrying a reward of one lakh rupees. He was wanted in 31 cases across five districts and had been absconding for a year. The arrest was made in Hapur. Kala Irani was also wanted in 41 crimes across eight states.
summary_points: A criminal carrying a one lakh rupee reward was arrested.
The arrest was made by the Uttar Pradesh STF in Hapur.
The criminal was wanted in 31 cases across five districts.
He had been absconding for one year.
The criminal was also wanted in 41 crimes across eight states.
title_hi: एक लाख के इनामी बदमाश को हापुड़ से गिरफ्तार किया गया
summary_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश एसटीएफ ने एक लाख रुपये के इनामी बदमाश, काला ईरानी को गिरफ्तार किया है। वह पांच जिलों में 31 मुकदमों में वांछित था और एक साल से फरार चल रहा था। गिरफ्तारी हापुड़ से हुई। काला ईरानी आठ राज्यों में 41 अपराधों में भी वांछित था।
